title: Deterministic Literary Publishing: A Multi-Layer Provenance Model for Verifiable Manuscripts
description: A multi-layer provenance architecture for literary publishing that replaces institutional trust with cryptographic verification. Combines Merkle tree hashing, content-addressed storage, deterministic build pipelines, and append-only blockchain records into a six-layer verification stack. Formalized as the Literary Protocol Standard (LPS-1) and validated through two literary works — a 75,000-word novel and a 13-story short fiction collection — demonstrating protocol generalization across formats, TTS engines, and tree topologies. Deployed across seven smart contracts on Polygon mainnet.
